FORM OF CONTRACT
Contract No. ND/2026/017: Upgrading of Covered Linkways and Drop-off Points at Seletar Hills Estate
SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE. All names, places and figures are fictional.
This Contract is made on 15 January 2026 between the Northshore Development Board (the Employer) and Riverbend Engineering Pte Ltd (the Contractor), following the Employer's Letter of Acceptance dated 5 January 2026.
The Conditions of Contract are the Public Sector Standard Conditions of Contract for Construction Works 2020, with Bills of Quantities.
The Superintending Officer is Ms Farah Iskandar, Director (Infrastructure), Northshore Development Board.
The Contract Sum is S$12,340,500.00, exclusive of GST.
Option Modules selected: Option Module 1 (Advance Payment) and Option Module 3 (Price Fluctuation).

APPENDIX TO THE CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT
Date of Commencement: 2 February 2026
Contract Period: 18 months from the Date of Commencement
Liquidated Damages: S$4,200 per day
Limit of liquidated damages: 10% of the Contract Sum
Defects Liability Period: 12 months
Performance security: 5% of the Contract Sum in the form of a banker's guarantee
Advance payment (Option Module 1): 10% of the Contract Sum
Retention: 5% of each interim payment, limited to 5% of the Contract Sum
Payment claims: the Contractor may submit a payment claim on the last working day of each month
Price fluctuation (Option Module 3): applies to steel reinforcement and ready-mixed concrete
Provisional sums: S$650,000.00 in total
Valuation of variations: at the rates in the Bills of Quantities where applicable
Dayworks: Schedule of Dayworks Rates in Part 5 of the Tender Documents
